body_text:
If $\gamma:[a,b]\to U$ is piecewise continuously differentiable
and $f:U\to\mathbb{C}$ is continuous, the contour integral is
$\int_\gamma f(z)\,dz=\int_a^b f(\gamma(t))\gamma'(t)\,dt$,
with the ordinary real integral applied to real and imaginary
parts. Orientation reversal changes the sign; an
orientation-preserving reparameterization does not change the
value.
